adapter_policy: The IN and OUT of each clip as last saved on the source timeline (user 2026-11-25): a Save that moved them writes the clip's row of clip_marks (view public_clip_marks); a clip's first Save keeps where they were before it. The table is journaled, so the project's journal keeps every write (who, when, before and after); the history of a clip is read from that journal, there is no second history. Going back to a position is a write like any other. A table module of the project database intermediary (qnc-db-broker); it owns only its table and is written only through the intermediary. The source timeline does not take its marks from here.
